statement: Fix three pairwise-skew lines and let Q be their unique smooth containing quadric. On the open set of fourth lines not contained in Q and disjoint from the first three, the four-lines problem has a nonreduced fibre exactly when the fourth line is tangent to Q: its two transversal solutions then coalesce. Equivalently the discriminant of the binary quadratic Q restricted to the fourth line is zero.

answer.text: Branch locus on this open chart: disc(Q|l₄)=0 (fourth line tangent to Q).

source.location: Section 1, four-lines argument and Figure 1, printed p. 3; real quadratic-intersection consequence

scope: The specified open chart with the first three lines fixed and the fourth line not contained in Q. Degenerate triples and fourth lines contained in Q are outside this statement.
notes: Derived directly from the cited bijection between solution lines and points of l_4∩Q. The condition is chart-specific and is not claimed to classify every degenerate four-line configuration.
